children: may fall into a range of $4.19-1/4 to $4.27-1/2 per bushel, as suggested by its wave pattern and a projection analysis.
The market has broken a support at $4.35-1/2, the 214.6% projection level of a wave 3 from $5.09-1/4. The next support is at $4.27-1/2, a break below which could open the way toward $4.19-1/4.
Based on the current wave count, the downtrend could extend far below $4.19-1/4. A closer look at the hourly chart reveals more fine-tuned targets and resistances.
A projection analysis on a wave c from $4.45-1/4 marks a target range of $4.28-1/2 to $4.31, which is above the range on the daily chart.
Resistance is at $4.36-1/4, a break above which may trigger a further bounce into $4.37-1/4 to $4.38-3/4 range.
